app.openFailed: Exhibit could not open its library. Check that its data folder is reachable, then try again.

common.libraryReadFailed: The library could not be read. Try again, or restart Exhibit if it keeps happening.
common.gone: It may have gone in the last scan. Go back to the collection.

actions.offlineDrive: The drive for {{drive}} is not connected
actions.otherBody: It leaves Movies and Shows and hangs with home videos and clips. Fix match brings it back.

playback.problem: {{message}} Download it, or choose where it is, in Settings.
playback.adviceOffline: Connect its drive, then play it again.
playback.adviceMissing: Check that the file is still in its folder, then play it again.
playback.adviceRetry: Play it again. If it keeps failing, restart Exhibit.

match.title: Fix match
match.noKey: Matching looks works up on TMDB, which needs a key. Add one in Settings, then fix the match again.
match.typeTitle: Type a title to look up.
match.nothing: Nothing on TMDB matches “{{title}}”. Try another spelling, or leave out the year.
match.nothingFrom: Nothing on TMDB matches “{{title}}” from {{year}}. Try another spelling, or leave out the year.

tools.mpvDoes: mpv plays your files and reads their details.
tools.ffmpegDoes: ffmpeg makes thumbnails for Other; mpv is used instead.
tools.alreadyLatest: You already have the latest build, from {{day}}.
tools.note: The download comes from shinchiro's builds on GitHub. A volunteer makes them, not the mpv or FFmpeg projects; mpv's own website lists them first.

secret.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard is empty. Copy the key, then paste it again.
secret.clipboardFailed: Exhibit could not read the clipboard. Type the key instead.

browser.readFailed: {{error}} Go back and choose another folder.

wall.noMoviesBody: Add a folder of films in Settings, or wait for the scan to finish.
wall.noShowsBody: Add a folder of series in Settings, or wait for the scan to finish.
wall.noOtherBody: Home videos, clips and files Exhibit cannot name hang here. Add a folder in Settings, or wait for the scan to finish.
wall.noMatchesBody: Turn one of them off, or clear them all.

home.noFolders: Add the folders that hold your films and shows in Settings.
home.allInOther: Home shows films and shows. Everything Exhibit has found so far is in Other.
home.looking: Exhibit is still looking through your folders.
home.foundNothing: Exhibit found nothing to show in your folders. Add another folder in Settings.

show.label: Show
show.noEpisodes: No episodes in this season yet.

details.notSure: Not sure this is the right title
details.fixInMenu: Fix match is in the menu

ask.searchFailed: The library could not be searched. Try again, or restart Exhibit if it keeps happening.
ask.hint: Type a title, or the name of someone who made it or is in it.

review.title: Needs review
review.readFailed: The list could not be read. Try again, or restart Exhibit if it keeps happening.
review.emptyBody: When Exhibit cannot tell what a file is, it asks here.
review.nothingClose: TMDB has nothing close to this name. Search by hand, or send it to Other.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readFailed: Settings could not be read. Try again, or restart Exhibit if it keeps happening.
settings.foldersNote: Where your films, shows and other videos are. Exhibit only reads them.
settings.noFolders: No folders yet. Add the folders that hold your films and shows.
settings.toolsNote: Free programs Exhibit uses to play your files and read them.
settings.tmdbNote: Names your films and shows and brings their posters. A key is free from themoviedb.org.
settings.checkingKey: Looking up titles with the new key
settings.keyRejected: TMDB rejected the key. Check the key, then save it again.
settings.agentNote: Used from the next version of Exhibit.
settings.languageNote: Exhibit's own words, and the titles, descriptions and posters it brings from TMDB.
settings.datesNote: How dates are written, whatever the language.
settings.displayNote: The intro plays as Exhibit opens.

firstRun.welcomeBody: Start with a folder that holds your films, shows or other videos. Exhibit reads it and never changes, moves or deletes anything in it.
firstRun.toolsBody_one: Exhibit plays your files with mpv and makes thumbnails with ffmpeg, two free programs. This one was not found on this computer. Exhibit can download both for you.
firstRun.toolsBody_other: Exhibit plays your files with mpv and makes thumbnails with ffmpeg, two free programs. These were not found on this computer. Exhibit can download both for you.
firstRun.mpvNeeded: Nothing can play until mpv is here.
firstRun.tmdbBody: With a key from TMDB, Exhibit names your films and shows and hangs their posters and backdrops.
firstRun.tmdbHow: The key is free: make an account at themoviedb.org, then copy the API key from your account's settings. You can skip this; Exhibit shows everything under its file names, and the key can be added later in Settings.

kind.source_offline: A drive is not connected. Connect it, then try again.
kind.tool: A media tool failed. Check the tools in Settings.
kind.provider: TMDB or GitHub could not be reached. Try again later.
kind.io: Exhibit could not read or write a file.
kind.db: The library could not be read. Restart Exhibit if it keeps happening.

tmdb.key_rejected: TMDB rejected the key. Check it in Settings.
tmdb.no_key: There is no TMDB key. Add one in Settings.
tmdb.unreachable: TMDB could not be reached. Check the internet connection, then try again.
tmdb.unreadable: TMDB sent something unreadable. Try again later.
tmdb.http: TMDB answered with error {{status}}. Try again later.

download.unreachable: Could not reach GitHub. Check the internet connection, then try again.
download.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting downloads for now. Try again in an hour.
download.http: GitHub answered with error {{status}}. Try again later.
download.interrupted: The download stopped. Check the internet connection, then try again.
download.unreadable: GitHub sent something unreadable. Try again later.
download.unexpected_release: The latest mpv release has an unexpected name. Try again in a day or two.
download.no_build: The latest release has no {{tool}} for this PC. Try again in a day or two.
download.windows_only: Downloading mpv and ffmpeg is only offered on Windows.
download.incomplete: The download did not hold mpv and ffmpeg. Try again in a day or two.
download.unpack: Could not unpack the download. Try again.
download.crashed: The download stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
download.no_tools_folder: This library has no folder for tools.

item.not_found: That title is no longer in the library.

match.not_a_file: Only a movie, an episode or an unidentified file can be matched.
match.no_episode_number: {{file}} has no episode number in its name, so its episode cannot be told.
match.several_episodes: Its files name more than one episode. Give each file its own episode number.

other.not_a_file: Only titles with files can go to Other.

play.no_episode: No episode of this show has a file.
play.no_file: This title has no file to play.

source.offline: The drive for {{path}} is not connected.
source.unknown_drive: Exhibit cannot tell which drive {{path}} is on.
source.overlaps: {{path}} overlaps {{other}}, which is already in Exhibit.
source.not_found: That folder is no longer in Exhibit.

library.no_wal: The library's folder cannot hold Exhibit's database. Move it to a local drive.

settings.unknown_language: Exhibit does not speak that language.
settings.unknown_date_format: There is no such date format.

secret.unknown: Exhibit has no key by that name.

identify.partly_failed: Some titles could not be looked up. They are tried again at the next scan.
